title: Store Setup Issues
description: Troubleshoot common store setup issues including theme problems, domain configuration, and store activation.
content:
Store Setup Issues

This guide helps you troubleshoot common issues when setting up your store, including theme problems, domain configuration, and activation issues.

Store Not Activating

Issues

  • Store remains inactive
  • Activation button not working
  • Error messages

Solutions

  • Check subscription plan limits
  • Verify store settings are complete
  • Review error messages
  • Check account status
  • Contact support if needed

Theme Not Applying

Problems

  • Theme not changing
  • Theme errors
  • Broken layout
  • Missing features

Solutions

  • Clear browser cache
  • Check theme compatibility
  • Review theme settings
  • Try different theme
  • Check for theme updates
  • Review error logs

Domain Configuration Issues

Problems

  • Domain not connecting
  • SSL certificate issues
  • DNS propagation delays
  • Domain verification failures

Solutions

  • Verify DNS settings
  • Wait for DNS propagation (24-48 hours)
  • Check SSL certificate status
  • Verify domain ownership
  • Review domain settings
  • Contact domain registrar

Store Not Loading

Issues

  • Store page not found
  • 404 errors
  • Slow loading
  • Blank page

Solutions

  • Check store status
  • Verify store URL
  • Clear cache
  • Check for maintenance mode
  • Review server logs
  • Test from different browser

Settings Not Saving

Problems

  • Changes not persisting
  • Settings reverting
  • Save button not working

Solutions

  • Check browser console for errors
  • Verify permissions
  • Try different browser
  • Clear cache and cookies
  • Check network connection
  • Review error messages

Product Display Issues

Problems

  • Products not showing
  • Wrong product display
  • Missing images
  • Layout issues

Solutions

  • Check product status
  • Verify product visibility
  • Check image uploads
  • Review theme settings
  • Clear cache
  • Check product settings

Checkout Issues

Problems

  • Checkout not loading
  • Payment methods missing
  • Shipping options not showing

Solutions

  • Verify payment gateway setup
  • Check shipping configuration
  • Review checkout settings
  • Test checkout process
  • Clear browser cache

Prevention Tips

  • Follow setup guides step-by-step
  • Test after each configuration
  • Keep backups
  • Document custom settings
  • Stay updated

Getting Help

If issues persist:

  • Review setup documentation
  • Check common issues guide
  • Contact support
  • Check system status
